headline: Wall Street Analysts See SLB (SLB) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), SLB (SLB) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?
